fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una fecha de caducidad al menos 3 meses posterior al día en que planeas salir del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area

entry.en: Your passport must have a date of issue less than 10 years before the date you arrive.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una fecha de expedición de menos de 10 años antes de la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: have a ‘date of issue’ less than 10 years before the date you arrive

entry.en: You can travel to the Schengen area, including Finland, without a visa for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
entry.es: Se puede viajar al espacio Schengen, incluida Finlandia, sin visado hasta 90 días en cualquier periodo de 180 días.
entry.quote: You can travel without a visa to the Schengen area, which includes Finland, for up to 90 days in any 180-day period without a visa.

entry.en: At Finnish border control you may also need to show a return or onward ticket.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo finlandés puede que también tengas que mostrar un billete de vuelta o de continuación.
entry.quote: show a return or onward ticket

entry.en: When entering the Schengen area for short stays you may need to register biometric details such as fingerprints and a photo.
entry.es: Al entrar en el espacio Schengen para estancias cortas, puede que debas registrar datos biométricos como huellas dactilares y una foto.
entry.quote: when you travel into the Schengen area for short stays, you may need to register your biometric details, such as fingerprints and a photo.

entry.en: You must declare cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 euros or more.
entry.es: Hay que declarar el efectivo o los cheques de viaje por valor de 10 000 euros o más.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 10,000 euros or more.

safety.en: Terrorist attacks in Finland cannot be ruled out.
safety.es: No se pueden descartar atentados terroristas en Finlandia.
safety.quote: Terrorist attacks in Finland cannot be ruled out.

safety.en: Pickpockets may target tourists in crowded areas during the tourist season.
safety.es: Los carteristas pueden actuar contra turistas en zonas concurridas durante la temporada turística.
safety.quote: Pickpockets may target tourists in the tourist season in crowded areas.

safety.en: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, are prohibited even in small quantities.
safety.es: Las drogas ilegales, incluido el cannabis, están prohibidas incluso en pequeñas cantidades.
safety.quote: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, are prohibited, even in small quantities.

safety.en: The drink-drive limit in Finland is significantly lower than the limit in England.
safety.es: El límite de alcohol al volante en Finlandia es significativamente más bajo que el de Inglaterra.
safety.quote: The drink-drive limit in Finland is significantly lower than the limit in England.

safety.en: Parts of Finland are in the Arctic Circle, where emergency medical assistance and search and rescue are limited.
safety.es: Partes de Finlandia están en el Círculo Polar Ártico, donde la asistencia médica de emergencia y el rescate son limitados.
safety.quote: Parts of Finland are in the Arctic Circle, including some very remote areas of land. Emergency medical assistance and search and rescue are limited in these areas.

safety.en: Bicycle thieves are said to be everywhere, so never leave your bike unlocked even for a minute.
safety.es: Se dice que hay ladrones de bicicletas por todas partes, así que nunca dejes tu bici sin candado ni un minuto.
safety.quote: Bicycle thieves are everywhere. Never leave your bike unlocked even for a minute.

health.en: The emergency medical number is 112; dial it and ask for an ambulance.
health.es: El número de emergencias médicas es el 112; marca y pide una ambulancia.
health.quote: Dial 112 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: You should have appropriate travel insurance for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation.
health.es: Debes tener un seguro de viaje adecuado para el tratamiento local o una evacuación médica inesperada.
health.quote: you have appropriate travel insurance for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation

health.en: To get medically necessary state healthcare in Finland you need a GHIC or an EHIC.
health.es: Para recibir atención sanitaria pública médicamente necesaria en Finlandia se necesita una tarjeta GHIC o EHIC.
health.quote: To get medically necessary state healthcare in Finland, you need a Global Health Insurance Card (GHIC) or a European Health Insurance Card (EHIC).

health.en: Tap water is always drinkable, except on trains and similar places where there will be warnings.
health.es: El agua del grifo siempre es potable, salvo en trenes y lugares similares, donde habrá avisos.
health.quote: tap water is always drinkable (except on trains etc., and there will be warnings in those cases)

health.en: Ticks are the most dangerous pests and may carry Lyme disease or tick-borne viral encephalitis.
health.es: Las garrapatas son las plagas más peligrosas y pueden transmitir la enfermedad de Lyme o la encefalitis vírica transmitida por garrapatas.
health.quote: The most dangerous pests are the ticks (Finnish: puutiainen or colloquially punkki, Swedish: fästing), which may carry Lyme's disease (borreliosis) or tick-borne viral encephalitis (TBE).

health.en: Medicines are strictly regulated, and non-trivial medications such as antibiotics require a prescription.
health.es: Los medicamentos están estrictamente regulados y los de cierta entidad, como los antibióticos, requieren receta.
health.quote: Medicines are strictly regulated. Any non-trivial medications, such as antibiotics, require a prescription.

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police is 112.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 112.

help.en: You can call FCDO in London 24 hours a day on 020 7008 5000 if something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.
help.es: Puedes llamar al FCDO en Londres las 24 horas al 020 7008 5000 si algo le ha ocurrido a un amigo o familiar en el extranjero.
help.quote:
You can call FCDO in London if you need urgent help because something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.

Telephone: 020 7008 5000 (24 hours)

getting_in.en: Finland's main international hub is Helsinki-Vantaa Airport (HEL), near Helsinki.
getting_in.es: El principal aeropuerto internacional de Finlandia es Helsinki-Vantaa (HEL), cerca de Helsinki.
getting_in.quote: Finland's main international hub is Helsinki-Vantaa Airport (HEL IATA) near Helsinki.

getting_in.en: Besides flights, common arrival routes are a ferry from Sweden (one night or day) and a shorter ferry from Estonia.
getting_in.es: Además de los vuelos, las rutas habituales son el ferri desde Suecia (una noche o un día) y un ferri más corto desde Estonia.
getting_in.quote: via Sweden, with a one-night (or day) ferry passage, via Estonia, with a shorter ferry passage

getting_in.en: The Finland–Russia border has been closed since 2023.
getting_in.es: La frontera entre Finlandia y Rusia está cerrada desde 2023.
getting_in.quote: Since 2023, the border has been closed.

getting_in.en: The borders to Norway and Sweden may be crossed at any point without a permit, provided you carry nothing requiring customs clearance.
getting_in.es: Las fronteras con Noruega y Suecia pueden cruzarse en cualquier punto sin permiso, siempre que no lleves nada que requiera despacho de aduana.
getting_in.quote: The borders to Norway and Sweden may be crossed at any point without a permit, provided that you're not carrying anything that requires customs clearance.

getting_in.en: Finland's only active international rail connection runs from Haparanda, Sweden, to Oulu.
getting_in.es: La única conexión ferroviaria internacional activa de Finlandia va de Haparanda (Suecia) a Oulu.
getting_in.quote: Finland's only active international rail connection is from Haparanda, Sweden, just across the border from Tornio, to Oulu.

getting_in.en: Unless going to northern Finland, the ferry from Stockholm is described as cheaper, faster and more enjoyable than the train.
getting_in.es: Salvo que vayas al norte de Finlandia, el ferri desde Estocolmo se describe como más barato, rápido y agradable que el tren.
getting_in.quote: Travelling by train from Stockholm to Helsinki takes a full day and requires at least three changes (and very long waits). Unless your destination is in northern Finland, taking the ferry will be cheaper, faster and more enjoyable.

getting_around.en: Trains are usually the most comfortable and fastest way to travel between cities, while buses may be needed for smaller towns and the countryside.
getting_around.es: Los trenes suelen ser el medio más cómodo y rápido entre ciudades, mientras que los autobuses pueden ser necesarios para pueblos pequeños y el campo.
getting_around.quote: Trains are usually the most comfortable and fastest method of inter-city travel, while bus may be needed for smaller towns and the countryside.

getting_around.en: Train tickets are mostly sold online, and tickets bought days or weeks in advance are often significantly cheaper.
getting_around.es: Los billetes de tren se venden sobre todo en línea, y los comprados con días o semanas de antelación suelen ser bastante más baratos.
getting_around.quote: Ticket sale is mostly online, with tickets bought days or weeks in advance often significantly cheaper

getting_around.en: Taxis are widely available, though in the countryside at night you may be out of luck and should call a local company in advance.
getting_around.es: Los taxis abundan, aunque en el campo por la noche puede que no encuentres uno y convenga llamar con antelación a una empresa local.
getting_around.quote: Taxis are widely available and comfortable, although in the countryside night you may nowadays be out of luck (call a local company in advance).

getting_around.en: Most taxi companies have a flag fall of €4–9 and the meter ticks up by about €2–4 per km.
getting_around.es: La mayoría de las empresas de taxi cobran una bajada de bandera de 4 a 9 € y el taxímetro suma unos 2 a 4 € por km.
getting_around.quote: Most companies have a flag fall of €4–9 (differing between daytime in weekdays and nights and weekends) and the meter ticking up by €2–4 per km or so

getting_around.en: A blood alcohol level over 0.05 % is considered drunk driving, and police enforce this with random roadblocks.
getting_around.es: Una alcoholemia superior al 0,05 % se considera conducción en estado de embriaguez y la policía lo controla con controles aleatorios.
getting_around.quote: A blood alcohol level of over 0.05 % is considered drunk driving. Finnish police strictly enforce this by random roadblocks and sobriety tests.

money.quote: Finland uses the euro, like several other European countries.

money.en: Credit cards, mainly Visa and MasterCard, are widely accepted, and contactless payment is commonplace.
money.es: Las tarjetas de crédito, sobre todo Visa y MasterCard, se aceptan ampliamente y el pago sin contacto es habitual.
money.quote: Credit cards – mainly VISA and MasterCard – are widely accepted, and contactless payment readers that also accept Google and Apple Pay are commonplace.

money.en: ATMs are common in cities and work with international credit and debit cards.
money.es: Los cajeros automáticos son comunes en las ciudades y funcionan con tarjetas de crédito y débito internacionales.
money.quote: Getting cash is rarely a problem in cities, as ATMs (pankkiautomaatti, bankautomat) are common and they can be operated with international credit and debit cards

money.en: Notes of €100, €200 and €500 are not dispensed by ATMs and are rarely used, so paying with them can be a hassle.
money.es: Los billetes de 100, 200 y 500 € no los dispensan los cajeros y casi no se usan, por lo que pagar con ellos puede ser un problema.
money.quote: Notes of €100, €200 and €500 are not dispensed by ATMs and are rarely actually used; prepare for a hassle if trying to pay with them.

money.en: A VAT of 25% is charged on nearly everything, with food mainly at 14%, and it must be included in the displayed price.
money.es: Se aplica un IVA del 25 % a casi todo, con la comida principalmente al 14 %, y debe estar incluido en el precio mostrado.
money.quote: A VAT of 25% is charged for nearly everything you buy (the main exception being food at 14%), but by law this must be included in the displayed price.

money.en: Non-EU residents can get a tax refund on purchases above €40 not intended for local use at participating outlets.
money.es: Los residentes fuera de la UE pueden obtener una devolución de impuestos por compras superiores a 40 € no destinadas a uso local en comercios adheridos.
money.quote: Non-EU residents can get a tax refund for purchases not intended for local use above €40 at participating outlets

etiquette.en: The standard greeting is a handshake.
etiquette.es: El saludo habitual es un apretón de manos.
etiquette.quote: The standard greeting is a handshake.

etiquette.en: If invited to a Finnish home, the only bad mistake visitors can make is not removing their shoes.
etiquette.es: Si te invitan a una casa finlandesa, el único error grave es no quitarte los zapatos.
etiquette.quote: If you are invited to a Finnish home, the only bad mistake visitors can make is not to remove their shoes.

etiquette.en: Punctuality is highly regarded, and a visitor should apologise even for being a few minutes late.
etiquette.es: La puntualidad es muy valorada y un visitante debe disculparse incluso por llegar unos minutos tarde.
etiquette.quote: Another highly regarded virtue in Finland is punctuality. A visitor should apologise even for being a few minutes late.

etiquette.en: Loud speaking and loud laughing is not normal in Finland and may irritate some Finns.
etiquette.es: Hablar o reír en voz alta no es normal en Finlandia y puede irritar a algunos finlandeses.
etiquette.quote: Loud speaking and loud laughing is not normal in Finland and may irritate some Finns.

etiquette.en: Finns are described as famously taciturn, so do not expect to hear "thank you" or "you're welcome" often.
etiquette.es: Se describe a los finlandeses como famosamente taciturnos, así que no esperes oír "gracias" o "de nada" a menudo.
etiquette.quote: Finns are a famously taciturn people who have little time for small talk or social niceties, so don't expect to hear phrases like "thank you" or "you're welcome" too often.

etiquette.en: Do not expect to be allowed to smoke indoors, not even in your own flat.
etiquette.es: No esperes que se permita fumar en interiores, ni siquiera en tu propio piso.
etiquette.quote: Don't expect to be allowed to smoke indoors, not even in your own flat.

connectivity.en: Modern 4G/5G networks blanket the country, though wilderness areas, typically in Lapland and the outer archipelago, may have poor signal.
connectivity.es: Las redes 4G/5G modernas cubren el país, aunque en zonas remotas, típicamente en Laponia y el archipiélago exterior, puede haber poca señal.
connectivity.quote: Modern 4G/5G networks blanket the country, although it's still possible to find wilderness areas with poor signal, typically in Lapland and the outer archipelago

connectivity.en: The 3G networks have been shut down.
connectivity.quote: The 3G networks have been shut down.

connectivity.en: The largest mobile operators are Telia, Elisa and DNA.
connectivity.es: Los mayores operadores móviles son Telia, Elisa y DNA.
connectivity.quote: The largest operators are Telia, Elisa (a Vodafone partner) and DNA.

connectivity.es: Los paquetes de prepago cuestan desde unos 5 €.
connectivity.quote: Prepaid packages cost from about €5, including all the price as value.

connectivity.en: Nearly every public library has free Wi-Fi, for which you ask for the codes.
connectivity.es: Casi todas las bibliotecas públicas tienen wifi gratis; hay que pedir los códigos.
connectivity.quote: nearly every public library has free Wi-Fi (ask for the codes)
